source.title: extra-eyes daemon spine cargo test pass

acquisition.details: Ran `cargo test` after implementing the initial Rust crate, eyesd daemon, IPC framing, state replay, and profile resolver. Result: 12 unit tests passed and 7 integration tests passed. Integration coverage includes status when absent, clean start/status/stop, double-start rejection, SIGTERM cleanup, SIGINT cleanup, orphaned Unix socket recovery, and `eyes profile resolve --json` for a project profile. Unit coverage includes project identity, runtime/state paths, IPC frame rejection, durable message/cursor replay, malformed final jsonl handling, strict profile field validation, supported harness acceptance, and unknown harness rejection.
